subject: design/installer-without-browser-review
statement: One tag (`vX.Y.Z`) on the source repo triggers the release workflow: build every engine binary under the command tree — the set **derived by scan, never hand-kept** (AP-27) — for each supported platform; pack the payload archive (the system tree the manifest enumerates), with no browser-runtime dependency bundle (§3.3); generate the release manifest (per-file hash + ownership class, per-binary per-platform sha256, the system version); publish the complete set with checksums through the distribution door contracted in the installer PRD §5.5. Publishing is **upload-or-verify re-runnable** (AP-22): a re-run of a partially-published release completes it or verifies it byte-for-byte — never a second, different artifact set under the same tag.
